sentences.text:
Mukesh Sharma vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 5 January,
2026
 Neutral Citation No. 2026:Mphc-Gwl:84
 1 
 In The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh

On The 5 th Of January, 2026
 Misc. Criminal Case No. 60124 of 2025
 Mukesh Sharma
 Versus
 The State Of Madhya Pradesh And Others
 Appearance:
 Shri Chetan Kanungo - Advocate for the applicant.
 Order

The applicant has filed this first bail application under Section 482 of the BNSS for grant of anticipatory bail to the applicant for the offence registered at Crime No.N.A. (Private Complainant)
1832/2022 of Police Station Ambha, District Morena for offence punishable under Sections 406,
409, 420, 467,468, 471 r/w 34 of IPC, 1860.
Learned counsel for the applicant prays for withdrawal of this first anticipatory application with liberty to surrender the applicant and seek regular bail.
However, the only anxiety of learned counsel for the applicant is expeditious hearing of his regular bail application.
Application is dismissed as withdrawn with aforesaid liberty.

It is expected that if applicant, after surrender, moves regular bail application before the competent Court/Sessions Court, then the same shall be decided as expeditiously as possible, preferably on the same day, on its NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2026:MPHC-GWL:84 2 MCRC-60124-2025 own merits in accordance with law.

(RAJESH KUMAR GUPTA ) JUDGE mani Mukesh Sharma vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 5 January, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/175197410/
1
